references.text: Deborah tells Barak that the Lord will go before him, reflecting the theme of the Lord leading his people down against the enemy together with his heroes.
Moses' blessing describes Israel as a people saved by the Lord, and their enemies shall submit. The theme of the Lord's people triumphing with the mighty is common.
The psalm describes God descending with his chariots and thousands of holy ones, reminiscent of the Lord's descent with his mighty ones.
The Lord calls his holy and mighty to battle, a theme reflected in the Lord going down with the heroes in Deborah's song.
The Song of the Well mentions nobles and princes digging the well, and the theme of leaders going before the people is parallel.
